title: Stay at the Serene La Dolce Vita | 30a Condo Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: La Dolce Vita in Rosemary Beach is a first floor flat that walks out to St. Augustine Greene and a splashpad, perfect for the kids! Book this 30A condo rental today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to the newly renovated La Dolce Vita!

This first floor, 2-bedroom, 2-bath flat designed by K. Lewis Interior Design is situated conveniently across from the Splash Pad and the St. Augustine Green and embodies a soft calming palette of sophisticated interiors.

Guests will enjoy a large, custom-built dining table and corner banquette with soft cushioned seat backs and benches that are nestled against the kitchen counter, which can be also be utilized as a buffet area for serving. The chef in your family will enjoy the deep farmhouse sink, new stainless steel appliances, and beautiful countertops providing a nice workspace to create meals. Laundry will be a breeze in the full-size, large capacity washer and dryer.

The living room is complete with sleeper sofa, swivel club chairs, cushioned bench and a 55” Roku Smart TV. Down the hallway you’ll find the guest bedroom with built-in queen over queen bunks. The stairs leading to the top bunk provide 4 spacious pull-out drawers to store clothing and essentials. The guest bedroom also includes a 43” Roku Smart TV and a closet with cubby shelving for shoes. The shelving also has HDMI cables and power outlets to connect your gaming system as well as a basket of puzzles and games that will make for fun-filled family nights during your stay.

Across the hallway is the guest bathroom with a single vanity and a shower-bathtub combination enclosed behind a frameless, classic roller-style sliding shower door. The beautifully constructed arched ceiling and shower walls are adorned with colorful subway tile and luxury fixtures. At the end of the hallway is the master bedroom with king-sized bed, large dresser, and 55” Roku Smart TV. The adjoining private bathroom boasts a double vanity providing an abundance of light and an expansive walk-in shower with seat and a petite Japanese soaking tub enclosed together behind a wall of glass. The white and gray porcelain tile covering the shower walls and floors coordinates peacefully with the clean airy hue of the master bedroom.

A gated porch off the living room provides a serene view of the Green, as well as several seating options for outdoor dining and entertaining. Guests can explore all that Rosemary Beach has to offer on 2 included adult bikes.

Additional Amenities:

1st floor unit

Roku TV's

dual-head walk-in shower

full size washer/dryer

blackout bedroom shades

USB electrical outlets

1 spot in the back of the building and additional street parking out front
